t: When you are comparing your results to someone else's
a: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
p: Wa an laysa li-l-insāni illā mā saʿā, wa anna saʿyahu sawfa yurā, thumma yujzāhu-l-jazā'a-l-awfā.
m: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives And that his effort is going to be seen - Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
